text: In this modern, well-lit space, I find myself pondering the boundaries between observer and participant. The glass-walled room with its sterile order and ongoing discussion hints at collaboration and rational inquiry. Yet, the angled perspective feels disorienting—reminding me that perspective shapes reality as much as any idea discussed within. I feel curious, yet vaguely unsettled by the transparency and angles, as if standing on the threshold of innovation and uncertainty.
